634:t_1:3.en:
???
「...But this plan too will be meaningless unless the coming dialogue takes place.」

634:t_1:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So he's the one who holds the key to it...」

634:t_1:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Thank you. Being able to speak with you like this has taught me a great deal.」

634:t_1:7.en:
???
「I'm the one who should thank you. Your existence proves the meaning of mine.」

634:t_1:8.en:
???
「And now that I've entrusted the entire plan to you, I think I'll go to sleep deep within this $$ヴェーダ$$.」

634:t_1:10.en:
???
「Your body and $$ガンダム$$ are already prepared. Ever since $$サイデリアル$$ invaded Earth, I was sure this day would come.」

634:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So everything has been in the palm of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s hand...」

634:t_1:12.en:
???
「That may have been true until now, but it won't be from now on.」

634:t_1:14.en:
???
「Together with $$ヴェーダ$$, I'll watch over your future... $$ティエリア$$... Go with them...」

634:t_1:15.en:
???
($$アムロ$$... The future we spoke about is almost here...)

634:t_1:22.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've given him every treatment we can, but...」

634:t_1:24.en:
$$フェルト$$
「According to $$ヴェーダ$$'s analysis, when he tried to share consciousness with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he couldn't process their vast information, and his brain cells were damaged.」

634:t_1:25.en:
$$キラ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ consciousness is so vast a human can't handle it...?」

634:t_1:26.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've performed a procedure to regenerate his brain cells, but... they say there could be lasting damage to his consciousness or memories...」

634:t_1:27.en:
$$アルト$$
「Letting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ know we mean them no harm... That might be the only way to end this battle, and yet...」

634:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「We don't have time to whine. Now we'll just have to stop them by force.」

634:t_1:29.en:
$$シン$$
「I hear the Federation forces are gathering every unit they can to intercept the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

634:t_1:30.en:
$n
「Apparently they've secured $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s cooperation too, but how long they can hold out...」

634:t_1:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Once we've resupplied, we'll be deploying immediately too...」

634:t_1:33.en:
$$葵$$
「It'll be all right, $$フェルト$$. We're $c, the ones who drove off even the $$新地球皇国$$.」

634:t_1:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll handle the fighting. Please stay with $$刹那$$, $$フェルト$$.」

634:t_1:35.en:
$n
($$刹那$$... You saved me when I was sinking into despair. I refuse to believe you'd meet your end here.)

634:t_1:36.en:
$$キラ$$
(You'll definitely come back... Until then, we'll manage somehow.)

634:t_1:42.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He still has unfinished business. He isn't the kind of man to abandon it.」

634:t_1:45.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to see where it leads too.」

634:t_1:47.en:
$$レド$$
「They aren't human... We can't speak to them... If there's something beyond those barriers, I want to know what it is.」

634:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Tell $$刹那$$ that if he'll show me that, I'll support him with everything I have.」

634:t_1:49.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hang in there, $$フェルト$$. Keep talking to $$刹那$$.」

634:t_1:50.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I'm sure your voice will reach him.」

634:t_1:52.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! You can't just suddenly start playing your guitar!」

634:t_1:53.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit nagging me about every little thing.」

634:t_1:54.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$刹那$$ should be saying that to you!」

634:t_1:55.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If he says it's too loud, I'll stop right away.」

634:t_1:56.en:
$$バサラ$$
「But listen! His song set my heart on fire! He's got the same soul as me!」

634:t_1:58.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Sorry, $$フェルト$$. He's doing this right beside a sick person.」

634:t_1:59.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But perhaps $$バサラ$$'s song could wake $$刹那$$ up.」

634:t_1:61.en:
$$エイミー$$
「A song can do that!?」

634:t_1:62.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I've seen a song bring back the consciousness of someone in a coma myself.」

634:t_1:63.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Was it $$バサラ$$'s song that did it?」

634:t_1:64.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「No... The one in the coma was $$バサラ$$.」

634:t_1:65.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Your singing back then... was wonderful, $$ガムリン$$.」

634:t_1:66.en:
$$レド$$
「Captain $$ガムリン$$'s song brought $$バサラ$$...」

634:t_1:67.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「What moves a person's heart... No, it doesn't matter whether they're human. It isn't how well or badly you sing.」

634:t_1:68.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's the strength of your feelings.」

634:t_1:70.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「So you do your best too, $$フェルト$$.」

634:t_1:71.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let him feel everything in your heart.」

634:t_1:72.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are you finished already, $$バサラ$$?」

634:t_1:73.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I've delivered my soul. Now $$刹那$$ just has to set his own soul on fire.」

634:t_1:75.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Then let's go. We're counting on you to look after $$刹那$$, $$フェルト$$.」

634:t_1:77.en:
$$フェルト$$
(You aren't alone... So many people are waiting for you.)

634:t_1:80.en:
$$グラハム$$
「...understand each other, you keep searching for a way, and you even try to do it with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

634:t_1:82.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Opening the way to the future... That is your battle, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...」

634:t_1:85.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I believe in you. I believe you'll wake up.」
